rules.name: CLAUDE.md exists at project root
rules.pass_msg: CLAUDE.md found — Claude has project context to work from.
rules.fail_msg: No CLAUDE.md found. Create one at your project root so Claude understands your codebase, conventions, and goals.

rules.name: CLAUDE.md contains structural headings
rules.pass_msg: CLAUDE.md uses headings to organize content — easy for Claude to navigate.
rules.fail_msg: CLAUDE.md has no Markdown headings. Add sections like '## Project Overview', '## Tech Stack', and '## Conventions' to give Claude clear structure.

rules.name: Subdirectory CLAUDE.md files exist
rules.pass_msg: Subdirectory CLAUDE.md files found — Claude gets fine-grained context per module.
rules.fail_msg: No subdirectory CLAUDE.md files found. Add CLAUDE.md files in key subdirectories (e.g., src/, lib/, docs/) to give Claude module-level context.

rules.name: .claude/ directory exists
rules.pass_msg: .claude/ directory found — project-level Claude configuration is in place.
rules.fail_msg: No .claude/ directory found. Create it to store Claude commands, settings, and project-specific configuration.

rules.name: Memory files are organized in .claude/
rules.pass_msg: Markdown files found inside .claude/ — memory is well-organized.
rules.fail_msg: No Markdown files found in .claude/. Consider adding structured memory files (e.g., .claude/context.md) to keep long-running project knowledge accessible.

rules.name: Claude settings file exists
rules.pass_msg: settings.json found in .claude/ — hook configuration has a home.
rules.fail_msg: No .claude/settings.json found. Create it to configure hooks and other Claude project settings.

rules.name: PreToolUse hooks are configured
rules.pass_msg: PreToolUse hooks are configured — Claude checks in before running tools.
rules.fail_msg: No PreToolUse hooks configured. Add hooks in .claude/settings.json to validate or log tool calls before they execute.

rules.name: PostToolUse hooks are configured
rules.pass_msg: PostToolUse hooks configured — Claude can react to tool results automatically.
rules.fail_msg: No PostToolUse hooks configured. Add PostToolUse hooks to log results, trigger side effects, or enforce post-conditions after tool runs.

rules.name: Hook script files exist
rules.pass_msg: Hook scripts found — automation is backed by real executable logic.
rules.fail_msg: No hook scripts found in .claude/hooks/. Create shell scripts there and reference them from settings.json to power your hooks.

rules.name: Stop hook for completion checks configured
rules.pass_msg: Stop hook configured — Claude can run final checks when sessions end.
rules.fail_msg: No Stop hook configured. Add a Stop hook to run post-session checks, summaries, or cleanup when Claude finishes a task.

rules.name: Custom agent definition files exist
rules.pass_msg: Custom agent files found — specialized sub-agents are ready to delegate to.
rules.fail_msg: No agent definition files found in .claude/agents/. Create Markdown agent files to define specialized agents Claude can spin up for subtasks.

rules.name: Agent files include a description field
rules.pass_msg: Agent files include descriptions — Claude knows when to invoke each agent.
rules.fail_msg: Agent files are missing 'description:' frontmatter. Add a clear description so Claude understands when to delegate to each agent.

rules.name: Multiple specialized agents defined
rules.pass_msg: Multiple agent files found — good specialization coverage across domains.
rules.fail_msg: Only one or no agents defined. Create separate agents for distinct domains (e.g., code-reviewer, test-writer, docs-writer) to maximize delegation efficiency.

rules.name: Agent tool restrictions are specified
rules.pass_msg: Agent tool restrictions found — agents are scoped to only the tools they need.
rules.fail_msg: No 'tools:' field found in agent files. Add tool restrictions to each agent to limit their capabilities and reduce risk of unintended actions.

rules.name: Agent descriptions include usage examples
rules.pass_msg: Agent files include examples — Claude can invoke agents with higher precision.
rules.fail_msg: Agent descriptions lack examples. Add example use cases or invocation patterns to help Claude know exactly when and how to use each agent.

rules.name: Git repository is initialized
rules.pass_msg: Git repository detected — version control is active.
rules.fail_msg: No Git repository found. Run 'git init' to initialize version control so Claude can track changes and work with branches safely.

rules.name: .gitignore file exists
rules.pass_msg: .gitignore found — sensitive and generated files are excluded from commits.
rules.fail_msg: No .gitignore found. Create one to prevent secrets, build artifacts, and node_modules from being committed to version control.

rules.name: Conventional commit message format adopted
rules.pass_msg: Conventional commit format is referenced in settings — structured commit history enabled.
rules.fail_msg: No conventional commit guidance found in settings. Add a commit convention note to CLAUDE.md or settings so Claude writes consistent, parseable commit messages.

rules.name: Branch strategy is documented
rules.pass_msg: Branch strategy referenced in CLAUDE.md — Claude follows your branching conventions.
rules.fail_msg: No branch strategy found in CLAUDE.md. Add a section describing your branching model (e.g., main/feature/hotfix) so Claude creates branches correctly.

rules.name: Pull request template exists
rules.pass_msg: PR template found — Claude can populate pull requests with structured information.
rules.fail_msg: No PR template found. Create .github/pull_request_template.md to guide Claude (and contributors) in writing consistent, thorough pull request descriptions.

rules.name: Custom slash commands exist
rules.pass_msg: Custom slash commands found — repeated tasks can be invoked with a single command.
rules.fail_msg: No custom commands found in .claude/commands/. Create Markdown command files to encode your most common Claude workflows as reusable slash commands.

rules.name: Commands include a description in frontmatter
rules.pass_msg: Command files include descriptions — users and Claude understand each command's purpose.
rules.fail_msg: Command files are missing 'description:' frontmatter. Add a description to each command so it appears clearly in /help and guides Claude on when to use it.

rules.name: At least 3 custom commands defined
rules.pass_msg: Multiple custom commands found — a solid command library is taking shape.
rules.fail_msg: Fewer than 3 custom commands found. Aim for at least 3 commands covering common workflows like code review, testing, and documentation to build a useful command library.

rules.name: Project-specific commands reference codebase patterns
rules.pass_msg: Commands use $ARGUMENTS — dynamic, reusable prompts are in use.
rules.fail_msg: No $ARGUMENTS usage found in commands. Use $ARGUMENTS placeholders to make commands dynamic and adaptable to different inputs at runtime.

rules.name: Command documentation or README exists
rules.pass_msg: Command README found — your command library is well-documented.
rules.fail_msg: No README found in .claude/commands/. Add a README.md to document your commands, their purpose, and usage examples for onboarding and reference.

rules.name: .claude/commands/ directory exists
rules.pass_msg: .claude/commands/ directory found — the foundation for custom commands is in place.
rules.fail_msg: No .claude/commands/ directory found. Create it and add Markdown files to define custom slash commands for your project workflows.

rules.name: At least 3 custom commands exist
rules.pass_msg: 3 or more custom commands found — a useful command toolkit is established.
rules.fail_msg: Fewer than 3 command files in .claude/commands/. Expand your command library to cover key workflows like /review, /test, and /deploy.

rules.name: Commands use YAML frontmatter
rules.pass_msg: Commands use YAML frontmatter — metadata like description and allowed-tools is structured correctly.
rules.fail_msg: Command files are missing YAML frontmatter (---). Add frontmatter blocks to define description, allowed-tools, and other metadata for each command.

rules.name: Reusable command patterns with allowed-tools
rules.pass_msg: Commands specify allowed-tools — tool access is scoped per command for safety and clarity.
rules.fail_msg: No 'allowed-tools:' found in command files. Add tool restrictions to each command to limit Claude's capabilities to only what each workflow needs.

rules.name: Command library README exists
rules.pass_msg: Command library README found — your commands are discoverable and well-documented.
rules.fail_msg: No README.md in .claude/commands/. Document your command library so teammates and future-you understand what each command does and when to use it.

rules.name: .env is listed in .gitignore
rules.pass_msg: .env is in .gitignore — environment secrets won't be accidentally committed.
rules.fail_msg: .env is not in .gitignore. Add '.env' and '.env.*' to your .gitignore immediately to prevent secrets from leaking into version control.

rules.name: No hardcoded secrets detected in CLAUDE.md
rules.pass_msg: No obvious hardcoded secrets found in CLAUDE.md — context file looks clean.
rules.fail_msg: Potential hardcoded secrets detected in CLAUDE.md. Remove any API keys, passwords, or tokens and replace them with references to environment variables.

rules.name: Permission mode is not set to YOLO
rules.pass_msg: Permissions field found in settings — Claude's access is explicitly configured.
rules.fail_msg: No permissions configuration found. Add a 'permissions' block to .claude/settings.json and avoid using permissive modes that skip tool confirmation prompts.

rules.name: Sensitive file protection hooks configured
rules.pass_msg: PreToolUse hooks are in place — sensitive file writes can be intercepted and validated.
rules.fail_msg: No PreToolUse hooks to protect sensitive files. Add hooks that check tool calls before execution to prevent Claude from accidentally modifying secrets or config files.

rules.name: MCP server configuration is present and audited
rules.pass_msg: MCP server configuration found — external integrations are explicitly declared.
rules.fail_msg: No mcpServers configuration found. If you use MCP servers, declare them explicitly in .claude/settings.json and review each server's permissions and trust level.
